title.zh-CN: 反复咳嗽、痰中带血加重 · 74岁女性
title.en: Worsening recurrent cough with blood-streaked sputum · 74-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 一位老年女性咳嗽、痰中带血已有十年，近来加重：判断先要排除什么、靠什么才能确诊、怎样安全地开始治疗，再沿着她多年的病程回看。
summary.en: An older woman's ten-year cough with blood-streaked sputum has worsened: judge what must be excluded first, what would settle the diagnosis and how to start treatment safely, then follow her course over the years.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对有类风湿关节炎、多年咳嗽和痰中带血、双肺多发空洞结节的患者，在任何免疫抑制治疗之前先按感染处理：实施空气传播隔离，送检痰抗酸涂片、分枝杆菌培养和核酸扩增检测（ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 结核病诊断指南；WHO 2019 结核感染预防与控制指南）。
learningOutcomes.en: In a patient with rheumatoid arthritis, years of cough with blood-streaked sputum and multiple cavitating lung nodules, manage the lesions as infectious before any immunosuppression: airborne precautions, and sputum for acid-fast smear, mycobacterial culture and a nucleic-acid amplification test (ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 TB diagnosis; WHO 2019 TB infection prevention and control).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 痰检阴性、抗感染后短暂好转又加重时，选择组织学诊断——查过血小板和凝血后做结节活检，同时送抗酸染色、真菌染色和培养——而不是升级抗生素、诊断性抗结核治疗或经验性激素。
learningOutcomes.en: When sputum tests are negative and the illness relapses after a brief response to antibiotics, choose tissue diagnosis — a nodule biopsy, after a platelet count and clotting screen, sent for acid-fast and fungal stains and cultures — over escalating antibiotics, a diagnostic anti-TB trial or an empirical glucocorticoid.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 结合高滴度类风湿因子和关节畸形，把“中央坏死、周围类上皮细胞栅栏状排列”的肺结节判读为类风湿结节，并说出定论之前还必须排除的分枝杆菌、真菌感染和血管炎。
learningOutcomes.en: Read a lung nodule with central necrosis ringed by palisading epithelioid cells, in a patient with high-titre rheumatoid factor and joint deformity, as a rheumatoid nodule — and name what must still be excluded before calling it: mycobacteria, fungi and vasculitis.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 为类风湿结节制订治疗：激素只作短期桥接并尽快减停，同时启用改善病情抗风湿药，并结合她的肺结节选药（EULAR 2022 及其 2025 更新）；开始前查乙肝和潜伏结核感染，大剂量时预防肺孢子菌（EULAR 2022 感染筛查与预防建议），长期用激素时评估骨折风险（ACR 2022 糖皮质激素性骨质疏松指南）。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan treatment for rheumatoid lung nodules: a glucocorticoid only as a short bridge, tapered and stopped as fast as feasible, with a csDMARD started alongside and chosen with her lung nodules in mind (EULAR 2022 and its 2025 update); hepatitis B and latent TB screening before starting, Pneumocystis prophylaxis at high doses (EULAR 2022 infection screening and prophylaxis) and a fracture-risk assessment for long-term use (ACR 2022 glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把免疫治疗用药不规律之后的复发当作免疫抑制宿主可能的新感染来处理：恢复激素之前先重新取样，再与风湿免疫科一起选用她能坚持的改善病情药，并解决用药依从性。
learningOutcomes.en: Treat a recurrence after irregular immunotherapy as a possible new infection in an immunosuppressed host: re-sample before restarting the glucocorticoid, then choose with rheumatology a DMARD she can keep taking, and address adherence.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明为什么一份在复发时同时调整了抗生素和激素的单例报告，不能判断究竟是哪一种治疗起了作用。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why a single report in which the antibiotics and a glucocorticoid were changed together at a recurrence cannot show which treatment worked.

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告改编。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用 1.0.0 版从报告中提取的内容——74岁女性，反复咳嗽、痰中带血 10 年，近 15 天加重；15 年前诊断类风湿关节炎、未系统治疗，无结核和糖尿病史；双肺小水泡音、双手掌指关节尺侧偏斜；首次胸部 CT、血红蛋白、类风湿因子、C 反应蛋白、血沉、ANA 谱和 ANCA；多次痰结核检查阴性；第二次住院的肺活检；抗感染、激素、复发和出院时的泼尼松——尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。分阶段设计、决策、处置选项、评分、医护角色和患者说出的担忧（教学设定，不增加临床事实）均为教学设计；未记录的内容（生命体征、白细胞和血小板、凝血、肝肾功能、痰检方法、活检取材与特殊染色、药名和剂量、复发间隔、长期随访）保持未知。保留的不一致：1.0.0 英文本称复发时抗感染 12 天后“影像未改善”，中文本只写“效果不佳”，两种说法都保留；1.0.0 把 74 岁时的就诊放在病程开头，是否确为首次住院待核实。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report. Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a 74-year-old woman with ten years of recurrent cough and blood-streaked sputum, worse for 15 days; rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed 15 years earlier and not consistently treated, with no history of tuberculosis or diabetes; fine crackles over both lungs and ulnar deviation at both hands' MCP joints; the first chest CT, haemoglobin, rheumatoid factor, CRP, ESR, ANA panel and ANCA; repeatedly negative sputum tests for tuberculosis; the lung biopsy at her second admission; the anti-infective and glucocorticoid treatment, the recurrence and the prednisone at discharge — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and time is relative. The phases, decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff and the patient's voiced worry (a teaching device that adds no clinical fact) are teaching design; what is not recorded (vital signs, white cells and platelets, clotting, liver and renal function, sputum methods, biopsy technique and special stains, drug names and doses, the interval before the recurrence, long-term follow-up) stays unknown. Inconsistencies kept: the English 1.0.0 text says imaging did not improve after 12 days of anti-infectives at the recurrence, the Chinese text only that the effect was poor — both readings are kept; and 1.0.0 places the encounter at age 74 at the start of the course, which is to be verified.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。病程和结果均来自原报告，不模拟未记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not for individual care or self-medication. The course and results come from the report; unrecorded physiological changes are not simulated.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 咳嗽好多年了，痰里带血，这些天更厉害了
chiefComplaint.en: I've had this cough for years, with blood in my phlegm, and it's got worse lately

triageNote.zh-CN: 74岁女性，今日收住院：反复咳嗽、痰中带血 10 年，近 15 天加重。
triageNote.en: 74-year-old woman admitted today with ten years of recurrent cough and blood-streaked sputum, worse for the last 15 days.

personality.zh-CN: 74岁女性，咳嗽、痰里带血拖了十年，这次加重住进了医院。她性子平和，被这病拖得有些灰心；问什么答什么，只说自己清楚的事，不清楚的就直说说不上来，从不猜。痰里有血让她一直放心不下。
personality.en: A 74-year-old woman whose cough and blood-streaked phlegm have dragged on for ten years and have now worsened enough to bring her into hospital. Even-tempered but a little disheartened by how long it has dragged on, she answers what she is asked and says only what she knows; when she does not know, she says so and never guesses. The blood in her phlegm keeps her uneasy.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 口语、短句，不用医学术语；说到病名只会说“类风湿”。
speechStyle.en: Plain, short sentences with no medical terms; the only diagnosis she names is her “rheumatoid arthritis”.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我这咳嗽又重了，痰里还带血。
openingLine.en: Doctor, my cough's got worse again, and there's blood in my phlegm.

concerns.zh-CN: 医生，我这不会是肺癌吧？
concerns.en: Doctor, it isn't lung cancer, is it?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：入院时她咳嗽、有些紧张，回答简短；抗感染后好了一阵、一周后又加重时，她有些失望；第二次住院时她配合检查，很想知道结果；数年后复发时她有些沮丧，承认免疫治疗用得断断续续；最后痰里的血止住、准备回家时，她松了一口气。只回答被问到的内容；不提化验、影像或病理结果，除了自己病程的年数和天数不说任何数字，不编造病史、用药、过敏或生活情况。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: on admission she coughs and is a little tense, answering briefly; after the brief improvement and the relapse a week later she is disappointed; at her second admission she goes along with the tests and wants to know what they show; at the recurrence years later she is downcast and admits she took the immune treatment on and off; at the end, with the blood gone from her phlegm and home in sight, she is relieved. She answers only what she is asked, never mentions tests, scans or pathology, gives no number other than the years and days of her own illness, and never invents history, medicines, allergies or circumstances.

description.zh-CN: 她因反复咳嗽、痰中带血 10 年、近 15 天加重住院。采集病史并查体，调阅入院影像和血液检查，决定首先要排除什么、现在先做什么。
description.en: She has been admitted with ten years of recurrent cough and blood-streaked sputum, worse over the last 15 days. Take the history, examine her, read the admission imaging and blood tests, and decide what must be excluded first and what to do now.

description.zh-CN: 她接受了抗感染治疗（药物未记录），曾短暂好转，一周后又加重。痰结核检查的结果已经回报。重新评估，决定下一步。
description.en: She was given anti-infective treatment (the drugs are not recorded), improved briefly and worsened again a week later. Her sputum results for tuberculosis are back. Reassess her and decide the next step.

description.zh-CN: 第二次住院期间为她做了肺活检（取材方式未记录）。阅读病理报告，作出诊断，并制订治疗方案。
description.en: During her second admission a lung biopsy was taken (how it was obtained is not recorded). Read the pathology report, make the diagnosis and set out the treatment plan.

description.zh-CN: 第二次住院加用激素后，她的影像有所好转。数年后（间隔未记录），在免疫治疗用得断断续续之后，病情复发；针对复发已抗感染治疗 12 天，效果不佳。重新评估并决定怎样处理。
description.en: After a glucocorticoid was added at her second admission, her imaging improved. Some years later (the interval is not recorded), after immunotherapy taken irregularly, the illness came back, and 12 days of anti-infective treatment for the recurrence have had little effect. Reassess her and decide what to do.

description.zh-CN: 查阅记录的后续经过与结局；更长期的随访没有记录。
description.en: Review the course and outcome as recorded; longer-term follow-up is not recorded.

name.zh-CN: 记录的后续经过与结局

text.zh-CN: 按记录：首轮抗感染治疗后短暂好转，一周后加重。第二次住院做了肺活检，之后加用激素，影像改善。数年后，在免疫治疗用药不规律之后病情复发；抗感染治疗 12 天效果不佳，影像未见改善。调整抗生素并加用激素后，痰中带血消失，空洞壁变薄，口服泼尼松出院。更长期的随访没有记录。
text.en: As recorded: after the first anti-infective course she improved briefly, then worsened a week later. At her second admission a lung biopsy was taken; a glucocorticoid was then added and her imaging improved. Some years later, after immunotherapy taken irregularly, the illness recurred; 12 days of anti-infective treatment had little effect and her imaging did not improve. After the antibiotics were changed and a glucocorticoid added, the blood in her sputum stopped and the cavity walls thinned; she was discharged on oral prednisone. Longer-term follow-up is not recorded.

note.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录各阶段所用抗生素和激素的药名、剂量，“免疫治疗”的具体药物，复发前间隔的年数，以及泼尼松的出院剂量和减量方案。这份记录的中英文表述在此处不同：对复发时 12 天的抗感染，中文只写“效果不佳”，英文写影像未改善。
note.en: This case records no antibiotic or glucocorticoid names or doses at any stage, which drug the “immunotherapy” was, how many years passed before the recurrence, or the prednisone dose and taper at discharge. The record's two language versions differ on the 12 days of anti-infectives at the recurrence: the Chinese says only that the effect was poor, the English that the imaging did not improve.

response.en: Anti-infective treatment started. This case records an anti-infective course at this stage but not the drugs, doses or route; what followed is shown in the next part of the case.

name.zh-CN: 诊断性抗结核治疗（四联）

dose.zh-CN: 异烟肼、利福平、吡嗪酰胺、乙胺丁醇四联口服（按体重给药），以病灶是否缩小来判断。
dose.en: Isoniazid, rifampicin, pyrazinamide and ethambutol by mouth (weight-banded doses), judged by whether the lesions shrink.

harm.zh-CN: 没有细菌学或组织学证据时，诊断性抗结核治疗既不能确诊也不能排除结核：数周后的影像变化难以解读，还会推迟本可通过组织学得到的诊断，并让 74 岁的她承受药物性肝损伤等风险。ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 结核病诊断指南要求先送检痰抗酸涂片、分枝杆菌培养和核酸扩增检测；痰检不能回答时，应取组织同时送染色和培养。
harm.en: Without bacteriological or tissue evidence, a diagnostic anti-TB trial neither proves nor excludes tuberculosis: the imaging response weeks later is hard to read, it delays the diagnosis tissue could give, and it exposes a 74-year-old to drug-induced liver injury. The ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 TB diagnosis guideline asks for sputum AFB smear, mycobacterial culture and a nucleic-acid amplification test first; when sputum cannot answer, obtain tissue for stains and culture.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 申请肺结节活检（CT 引导经皮或经支气管镜）
name.en: Request a lung nodule biopsy (CT-guided percutaneous or bronchoscopic)

dose.zh-CN: 先查血小板计数和凝血功能；取材送组织病理，同时送抗酸染色、真菌染色以及分枝杆菌和真菌培养。
dose.en: Check the platelet count and clotting first; send the tissue for histology with acid-fast and fungal stains, and for mycobacterial and fungal culture.

harm.zh-CN: 经皮肺穿刺或经支气管活检之前要知道血小板计数和凝血功能：她的血常规只记录了血红蛋白，血小板和凝血都没有结果。先查，再取材。
harm.en: A percutaneous or transbronchial biopsy needs a known platelet count and clotting screen first: her blood count records only the haemoglobin, with no platelet or clotting result. Check them, then biopsy.

response.zh-CN: 已申请活检。她的病历中有第二次住院时的肺活检病理报告（右下叶结节；取材方式未记录），在下一阶段展示。
response.en: Biopsy requested. Her record holds the pathology report of a lung biopsy from her second admission (a right lower-lobe nodule; how it was taken is not recorded), shown in the next part of the case.

name.zh-CN: 全身糖皮质激素（泼尼松口服）

dose.zh-CN: 泼尼松每日一次口服，起始剂量和减量方案与风湿免疫科共同制订，用最低有效剂量、尽量短的疗程；只在痰分枝杆菌结果和组织学都已阅读、并已申请标本抗酸和真菌染色之后开始，复发时须先重新送检痰标本。
dose.en: Prednisone by mouth once daily, starting dose and taper agreed with rheumatology, at the lowest effective dose for the shortest time; start only once the sputum mycobacterial results and the histology have been read and the specimen's acid-fast and fungal stains requested, and at a recurrence only after fresh sputum has been sent.

harm.zh-CN: 在痰分枝杆菌结果和组织学出来之前——或复发时在重新送检之前——用激素，可能让未被发现的结核或真菌感染扩散，同时掩盖它的表现。双肺空洞结节在排除感染之前不能按炎症治疗：ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 和 WHO 2019 先要求送检痰并隔离，EULAR 2022 感染筛查与预防建议也提出用激素前应考虑筛查潜伏结核。
harm.en: A glucocorticoid before the sputum mycobacterial results and the histology are in — or, at a recurrence, before fresh sputum has been sent — can let undetected tuberculosis or a fungal infection spread while masking its signs. Cavitating nodules are not treated as inflammation until infection is excluded: ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 and WHO 2019 put sputum testing and isolation first, and the EULAR 2022 infection recommendations advise considering latent TB screening before glucocorticoids.

response.zh-CN: 已开始口服激素。本病例没有记录激素的剂量；不模拟其效果，之后的经过在后面的阶段展示。
response.en: Glucocorticoid started. This case records no glucocorticoid dose; it does not simulate the effect — what followed is shown in the later parts of the case.

name.zh-CN: 甲泼尼龙静脉冲击

dose.zh-CN: 甲泼尼龙 500–1000 mg 静脉滴注，每日一次，连用 3 天。
dose.en: Methylprednisolone 500–1000 mg IV once daily for 3 days.

harm.zh-CN: 冲击剂量的激素用于危及器官或生命的病变（如重症血管炎），类风湿结节不属于此类。对一位双肺有空洞、感染尚未排除或尚未重新排除的 74 岁患者，冲击治疗会成倍增加结核、真菌和其他机会性感染的风险；EULAR 2022 感染筛查与预防建议对每日超过 15–30 mg 泼尼松当量、超过 2–4 周的治疗已建议考虑预防肺孢子菌。
harm.en: Pulse doses are for organ- or life-threatening disease such as severe vasculitis, which rheumatoid nodules are not. In a 74-year-old with cavitating lungs and infection not excluded, or not excluded again, a pulse multiplies the risk of tuberculosis, fungal and other opportunistic infection; the EULAR 2022 infection recommendations already advise considering Pneumocystis prophylaxis above 15–30 mg prednisolone equivalent a day for more than 2–4 weeks.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 长期激素的伴随预防（肺孢子菌、骨骼）
name.en: Companion prophylaxis for long-term glucocorticoid (Pneumocystis, bone)

dose.zh-CN: 泼尼松每日超过 15–30 mg、预计超过 2–4 周时，考虑复方磺胺甲噁唑预防肺孢子菌肺炎（EULAR 2022）；每日 ≥ 2.5 mg、预计超过 3 个月时，尽早评估骨折风险（骨密度、椎体影像、FRAX），中高危者加用抗骨质疏松药（ACR 2022），并保证钙和维生素 D 摄入。
dose.en: Consider co-trimoxazole against Pneumocystis when prednisone exceeds 15–30 mg a day for more than 2–4 weeks (EULAR 2022); for ≥ 2.5 mg a day expected beyond 3 months, assess fracture risk early (bone density, vertebral imaging, FRAX) and add osteoporosis treatment at medium or higher risk (ACR 2022), with adequate calcium and vitamin D.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 风湿免疫科共管：启用改善病情抗风湿药
name.en: Joint care with rheumatology: start a csDMARD

dose.zh-CN: 与风湿免疫科共同启用传统合成改善病情抗风湿药，按达标治疗定期复诊（EULAR 2022 及其 2025 更新）。甲氨蝶呤是常用的锚定药，但它可加速类风湿结节形成（肺内结节也可受累），原有肺部病变还会增加其肺炎风险；她双肺有空洞结节、肾功能未记录，用甲氨蝶呤还是柳氮磺吡啶、来氟米特等替代药，要与风湿免疫科共同决定。
dose.en: Start a conventional synthetic DMARD with rheumatology and treat to target with regular review (EULAR 2022 and its 2025 update). Methotrexate is the usual anchor, but it can accelerate rheumatoid nodulosis — in the lung too — and pre-existing lung disease raises its pneumonitis risk, so with her cavitating nodules and unrecorded renal function the agent (methotrexate or an alternative such as sulfasalazine or leflunomide) is chosen with rheumatology.

response.zh-CN: 已请风湿免疫科共管。本病例没有记录这一阶段是否启用了改善病情抗风湿药；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Rheumatology is now involved. This case does not record whether a DMARD was started at this stage; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 调整抗生素方案

dose.zh-CN: 依据新的培养和药敏结果调整抗菌药；没有新的病原学结果时，单纯换药难以判断效果。
dose.en: Adjust the antibacterial agent by fresh culture and sensitivity results; without new microbiology, a switch alone is hard to judge.

response.zh-CN: 已调整抗生素。本病例没有记录任何阶段所用抗生素的药名；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Antibiotics changed. This case records no antibiotic names at any stage; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 出院计划与随访安排

dose.zh-CN: 写明泼尼松剂量和减量时间表；规律服用改善病情抗风湿药并核对依从性；继续伴随预防；风湿免疫科和呼吸科门诊共同随访并复查胸部影像；交代咯血加重、发热或气短时及时返院。
dose.en: A written prednisone dose and taper schedule; the DMARD taken regularly, with adherence checked; the companion prophylaxis continued; shared rheumatology and respiratory clinic follow-up with repeat chest imaging; and clear advice to return with heavier bleeding, fever or breathlessness.

response.zh-CN: 已列入计划。本病例没有记录剂量、减量方案或随访安排；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Added to the plan. This case records no dose, taper or follow-up arrangement; it does not simulate the effect.

title.zh-CN: 理清十年咳嗽与痰中带血的来龙去脉
title.en: Take the story of her ten-year cough and blood-streaked sputum

hint.zh-CN: 这么长的病程，哪些情况能帮你区分感染、炎症和肿瘤？关于出血、她以前得过的病和用过的药，你还需要问清什么？
hint.en: Over a course this long, what would help you tell infection, inflammation and tumour apart — and what must you still learn about bleeding, her past illnesses and her medicines?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁问清咳嗽和痰中带血的时间、规律和量，别处有无出血，以及她的既往病史（包括结核）和用药。
guidance.en: At the bedside, establish how long the cough and blood-streaked sputum have lasted, their pattern and amount, any bleeding elsewhere, and her past history (including tuberculosis) and medicines.

title.en: Examine her and read the admission records

hint.zh-CN: 她的胸部和双手能告诉你什么？影像上的病灶和血液检查结果，哪些互相印证，哪些还解释不了？
hint.en: What can her chest and her hands tell you? Which imaging and blood findings fit together, and which remain unexplained?

guidance.zh-CN: 听诊双肺、检查双手关节；调阅胸部影像，送检并阅读血常规与炎症指标、类风湿因子和自身抗体。
guidance.en: Listen to her lungs and examine her hands; read the chest imaging, and send and read the blood count with inflammatory markers and the rheumatoid factor with autoantibodies.

title.zh-CN: 决定首先排除什么，并付诸行动
title.en: Decide what to exclude first, and act on it

hint.zh-CN: 在使用任何抑制免疫的治疗之前，哪一种可治、又会传染的空洞病因必须先排除？查清之前，怎样保护病房里的其他人？
hint.en: Before any treatment that dampens the immune system, which treatable and transmissible cause of cavities must be excluded — and how do you protect others on the ward until you know?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板作答决策 1，再把计划付诸行动：送检痰、隔离或开始治疗。行动之后，病例才进入首轮治疗之后的阶段。
guidance.en: Answer decision 1 on the case board, then act on your plan — send sputum, isolate her or start treatment. The course after the first treatment opens once you have acted.

title.en: Reassess her after the first treatment

hint.zh-CN: 短暂好转又加重，说明了什么、又不能说明什么？痰检阴性能排除哪些病，排除不了哪些？要确诊还缺什么，取材之前要先确认什么？
hint.en: What does a brief response followed by relapse show — and what can it not show? What do negative sputum results exclude, and what not? What is still missing for a diagnosis, and what must you check before getting it?

guidance.zh-CN: 问她用药后的情况，送检并阅读本阶段的痰结核检查结果，作答决策 2，再把你的选择付诸行动。
guidance.en: Ask how she has been since the treatment, order and read this stage's sputum results for tuberculosis, answer decision 2 and act on your choice.

title.zh-CN: 作出诊断并制订治疗方案
title.en: Make the diagnosis and plan treatment

hint.zh-CN: 在她这样的患者身上，哪几种病会出现坏死周围栅栏状排列的结构？报告还缺哪些染色或培养？长期用激素之前，要先查什么、同时预防什么？
hint.en: In a patient like her, which conditions can produce necrosis ringed by palisading cells — and which stains or cultures does the report still lack? Before long-term glucocorticoid, what must you test for first, and what must you prevent alongside it?

guidance.zh-CN: 阅读第二次住院的病理报告，申请标本的特殊染色和培养，作答决策 3 和决策 4，并开出相应的检查和治疗。
guidance.en: Read the pathology report from her second admission, ask for the specimen's stains and cultures, answer decisions 3 and 4, and order the tests and treatment that follow.

title.zh-CN: 跟进此后的病程并回看结局
title.en: Follow her later course and review the outcome

hint.zh-CN: 对用过免疫治疗的人，复发时最不能漏掉什么？加强任何治疗之前要先做什么？记录的结局能证明是哪一种治疗起了作用吗？
hint.en: In someone on immune treatment, what must you not miss at a recurrence, and what has to happen before any treatment is stepped up? Can the recorded outcome show which treatment worked?

guidance.zh-CN: 问清这次复发的经过和她的用药情况，调阅本次影像，作答决策 5；然后在病历终端查阅记录的后续经过与结局。
guidance.en: Ask about the recurrence and how she took her treatment, read the current imaging and answer decision 5; then read the recorded course and outcome at a records terminal.

prompt.zh-CN: 邹女士 74 岁，15 年前诊断类风湿关节炎、一直没有好好治疗，从未得过结核；咳嗽、痰中带血 10 年，近 15 天加重。查体：双肺小水泡音，双手掌指关节尺侧偏斜。胸部 CT：双肺多发大小不等的结节，伴大小不等的空洞。血红蛋白 95 g/L，C 反应蛋白 95 mg/L，血沉 90 mm/h，类风湿因子 2010 IU/mL；所查 ANA 谱和 ANCA 阴性。你首先做什么？
prompt.en: Ms Zou, 74, had rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed 15 years ago and never really treated, and has never had TB. She has had a cough with blood-streaked sputum for ten years, worse for 15 days. Fine crackles over both lungs; ulnar deviation at both hands' MCP joints. Chest CT: multiple nodules of varying size in both lungs, with cavities of varying size. Hb 95 g/L, CRP 95 mg/L, ESR 90 mm/h, RF 2010 IU/mL; the ANA panel and ANCA negative. What do you do first?

need.zh-CN: 先问清咳嗽和血痰的时长、她的既往病史（包括结核）并查体，再调阅入院影像、血液检查和自身抗体。
need.en: First establish how long the cough and bloody sputum have lasted and her past history (including TB), examine her, and read the admission imaging, blood tests and autoantibodies.

text.zh-CN: 先按感染处理、排除结核：空气传播隔离，送检痰抗酸涂片、分枝杆菌培养和分子检测，结果出来前不用激素
text.en: Infection first: airborne precautions and sputum for acid-fast smear, mycobacterial culture and a molecular test, with no steroid until the results are back

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。双肺空洞结节伴痰中带血，首先要排除可治又会传染的肺结核，以及其他分枝杆菌和真菌感染；类风湿结节只能在排除感染之后诊断。ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 结核病诊断指南要求送检痰抗酸涂片、分枝杆菌培养和核酸扩增检测，WHO 2019 结核感染预防与控制指南要求对疑似传染性肺结核的患者实施呼吸道隔离；结果出来之前用激素，可能让未被发现的感染扩散。
feedback.en: Correct. Cavitating nodules with blood-streaked sputum call first for the exclusion of tuberculosis — treatable and transmissible — and of other mycobacterial and fungal infection; rheumatoid nodules are diagnosed only once infection is excluded. The ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 TB diagnosis guideline asks for sputum AFB smear, mycobacterial culture and a nucleic-acid amplification test, and the WHO 2019 TB infection-control guideline isolates people with presumed infectious TB; a glucocorticoid before the results could let an undetected infection spread.

text.zh-CN: 类风湿因子 2010 IU/mL 加上双手尺偏，最可能是类风湿肺结节：现在就开始泼尼松，4 周后复查 CT 看反应
text.en: With RF 2010 IU/mL and ulnar deviation, rheumatoid lung nodules are most likely: start prednisone now and repeat the CT in four weeks to judge the response

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。高滴度类风湿因子和关节畸形说明她患有病程很长的血清阳性类风湿关节炎，却不能说明肺部空洞的原因——类风湿患者同样会得结核和真菌感染，而激素会让它们恶化。EULAR 2022 感染筛查与预防建议提出用激素前应考虑筛查潜伏结核；在痰检和组织学之前，空洞结节不能按炎症来治。
feedback.en: No. High-titre RF and joint deformity show long-standing seropositive rheumatoid arthritis, not the cause of the cavities — people with RA get tuberculosis and fungal infection too, and a glucocorticoid makes both worse. The EULAR 2022 infection recommendations advise considering latent TB screening before glucocorticoids; cavitating nodules are not treated as inflammation before the sputum results and tissue.

text.zh-CN: 老年人双肺空洞首先就是肺结核：不等痰检结果，今天就开始四联抗结核治疗，按病灶变化来判断
text.en: Cavities in an older woman are tuberculosis until proven otherwise: start four-drug anti-TB treatment today without waiting for sputum, and judge by the lesions

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。怀疑结核是对的，但应先取得细菌学证据：ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 指南要求在治疗前送检痰涂片、培养和核酸扩增检测，培养阳性还能做药敏试验。不送检就开始四联治疗，之后的诊断将无从确认，还让 74 岁的她承受药物性肝损伤等不良反应。
feedback.en: No. Suspecting TB is right, but secure the bacteriology first: the ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 guideline asks for sputum smear, culture and nucleic-acid amplification before treatment, and a positive culture gives drug susceptibility. Four drugs without samples leave the diagnosis unconfirmable and expose a 74-year-old to drug-induced liver injury.

text.zh-CN: 按细菌性肺脓肿处理：静脉经验性抗生素，一周后复查 CT，如果好转就不必再查结核
text.en: Treat it as a bacterial lung abscess: empirical intravenous antibiotics and a repeat CT in a week, with no TB work-up if she improves

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。经验性抗菌治疗可以同时进行，但代替不了结核检查：多发空洞、病程 10 年、痰中带血，正是必须排除结核和真菌的情形，症状一时好转也排除不了结核——ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 指南要求疑似患者送检痰抗酸涂片、培养和核酸扩增检测；在此期间她若有传染性，病房里的其他人都在暴露之中（WHO 2019 要求隔离疑似传染性患者）。记录中的团队在这一阶段也给了抗感染治疗。
feedback.en: No. Empirical antibacterial treatment may run alongside, but it does not replace the TB work-up: multiple cavities, ten years of symptoms and blood-streaked sputum are exactly where tuberculosis and fungi must be excluded, and a passing improvement excludes neither — ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 asks for sputum AFB smear, culture and nucleic-acid amplification in suspected TB. Meanwhile, if she is infectious, others on the ward are exposed (WHO 2019 isolates presumed infectious TB). The recorded team also gave anti-infective treatment at this stage.

text.zh-CN: 74 岁、双肺多发空洞结节，首先考虑转移癌：先安排 PET-CT 和肿瘤科会诊，感染方面的检查以后再做
text.en: Multiple cavitating nodules at 74 point first to metastatic cancer: arrange PET-CT and an oncology referral now, and leave the infection tests for later

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。肿瘤要考虑，但不能排在感染检查之前：结核可治又会传染，痰检简便快速，ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 指南要求疑似患者先送检痰。感染性和炎症性结节在 PET-CT 上同样会摄取示踪剂，无法据此与肿瘤区分，最终仍要靠组织学。
feedback.en: No. Cancer belongs on the list, but not ahead of the infection work-up: tuberculosis is treatable and transmissible, sputum tests are quick, and the ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 guideline sends sputum first in suspected TB. Infective and inflammatory nodules take up tracer on PET-CT too, so it cannot separate them from cancer — tissue still decides.

prompt.zh-CN: 首轮抗感染治疗后她短暂好转，一周后又加重。多次痰结核检查阴性。下一步怎么做？
prompt.en: After the first anti-infective course she improved briefly, then worsened a week later. Repeated sputum examinations for tuberculosis were negative. What next?

need.zh-CN: 先问她用药后的情况，并阅读本阶段的痰结核检查结果。
need.en: First ask how she has been since the treatment, and read this stage's sputum results for tuberculosis.

text.zh-CN: 取组织：先查血小板和凝血，再做结节活检，送病理及抗酸、真菌染色和培养；病理出来前不用激素
text.en: Get tissue: after platelets and clotting are checked, biopsy a nodule for histology, acid-fast and fungal stains and cultures; no steroid until it is read

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。抗感染后短暂好转再加重、痰检阴性，既不能证明细菌感染，也排除不了结核或真菌；类风湿结节、血管炎和肿瘤同样只能靠组织区分。活检同时送抗酸染色、真菌染色和培养，一次取材就能回答感染与炎症两个问题；ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 指南提醒，涂片阴性不能排除结核，培养仍是参考标准。她的血小板和凝血没有记录，取材前要先查。
feedback.en: Correct. A brief response and relapse with negative sputum neither proves bacterial infection nor excludes tuberculosis or fungi, and rheumatoid nodules, vasculitis and tumour are told apart only on tissue. A biopsy sent for acid-fast and fungal stains and cultures answers the infection and the inflammation questions at once; ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 is clear that negative smears do not exclude TB and that culture remains the reference standard. Her platelets and clotting are not recorded, so check them first.

text.zh-CN: 短暂好转说明是细菌感染：换用更广谱的静脉抗生素再治 2 周，复查 CT 之后再考虑别的检查
text.en: The brief response shows a bacterial infection: switch to broader intravenous antibiotics for two more weeks and re-image before considering any other test

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。许多非感染性病变在抗感染期间也会自行波动，一周后又加重恰恰说明抗生素没有解决问题。没有病原学或组织学证据就升级抗生素，只会推迟诊断、增加耐药和不良反应；方案里若有氟喹诺酮，还可能部分治疗并掩盖结核（ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 以培养为结核诊断的参考标准）。
feedback.en: No. Many non-infective processes wax and wane during antibiotics, and relapse within a week shows the antibiotics did not solve the problem. Escalating without microbiology or tissue delays the diagnosis and adds resistance and side effects — and a fluoroquinolone in the regimen can partly treat and mask tuberculosis (ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 keeps culture as the reference standard).

text.zh-CN: 痰检阴性也排除不了结核：给 2 个月诊断性抗结核治疗，按空洞是否缩小来判断是不是结核
text.en: Negative sputum does not exclude TB: give two months of diagnostic four-drug anti-TB treatment and decide by whether the cavities shrink on CT

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。痰检阴性确实不能排除结核，但答案是取组织做培养，而不是用治疗反应来诊断：类风湿结节和许多感染都会自行波动，2 个月后的影像变化无法解读，四联用药还有肝毒性。ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 指南以培养作为结核诊断的参考标准。
feedback.en: No. Negative sputum indeed does not exclude TB, but the answer is tissue and culture, not a diagnosis by response: rheumatoid nodules and many infections wax and wane, so imaging after two months cannot be read, and four drugs carry liver toxicity. The ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 guideline keeps culture as the reference standard for TB.

text.zh-CN: 抗感染无效说明是炎症而不是感染：停用抗生素，直接开始泼尼松，不必等组织学结果
text.en: Failure of antibiotics shows inflammation rather than infection: stop the antibiotics and start prednisone now, without waiting for tissue

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。抗生素无效不等于没有感染——结核、非结核分枝杆菌和真菌本来就对普通抗生素无反应。不取组织就用激素，可能让这些感染播散；EULAR 2022 感染筛查与预防建议提出用激素前应考虑筛查潜伏结核，可能活动的结核更要先排除。
feedback.en: No. Antibiotic failure is not absence of infection — tuberculosis, non-tuberculous mycobacteria and fungi do not respond to ordinary antibiotics anyway. A glucocorticoid without tissue can let them disseminate; the EULAR 2022 infection recommendations advise considering latent TB screening before glucocorticoids, and possible active disease must be excluded all the more.

text.zh-CN: 痰检阴性：先让她出院，3 个月后复查 CT 就行，类风湿患者的肺结节不需要进一步检查
text.en: Sputum is negative: discharge her and repeat the CT in three months, since lung nodules in rheumatoid arthritis need no further tests

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。她的咳嗽和痰中带血在加重，C 反应蛋白和血沉明显升高，病灶有空洞——这不是可以观察的偶发结节。痰检阴性降低但不排除分枝杆菌感染（ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017），诊断没有确立，治疗也就无从开始。
feedback.en: No. Her cough and bloody sputum are worsening, her CRP and ESR are high and the lesions cavitate — these are not incidental nodules to watch. Negative sputum lowers but does not exclude mycobacterial infection (ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017); without a diagnosis, treatment cannot begin.

prompt.zh-CN: 第二次住院的肺活检（右下叶结节）：中央急性炎性坏死伴少许纤维素样物质，周围类上皮细胞栅栏状排列，间质淋巴细胞浸润。结合她的病史、查体和血清学，你的判读是什么？
prompt.en: Biopsy at her second admission (right lower-lobe nodule): central acute inflammatory necrosis with a little fibrinoid material, ringed by palisading epithelioid cells, with interstitial lymphocytic infiltration. Taken with her history, examination and serology, what is your reading?

need.zh-CN: 先在本阶段阅读第二次住院的病理报告。
need.en: First read the pathology report from her second admission in this stage.

text.zh-CN: 类风湿（坏死性）结节，与她的类风湿关节炎相符——前提是标本的抗酸、真菌染色和培养阴性，且没有血管炎
text.en: Rheumatoid (necrobiotic) nodules, in keeping with her arthritis — provided the tissue's acid-fast and fungal stains and cultures are negative and there is no vasculitis

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。中央坏死伴纤维素样物质、周围类上皮细胞（组织细胞）栅栏状排列并有淋巴细胞浸润，是类风湿结节的结构；她有 15 年类风湿关节炎、双手尺偏和高滴度类风湿因子，坏死结节形成空洞也说得通。但结核和真菌肉芽肿同样可见坏死伴类上皮细胞，报告没有记录特殊染色和培养，要请病理科补做；EULAR 2022 感染筛查与预防建议也要求在加强免疫抑制之前明确感染状况。
feedback.en: Correct. Central necrosis with fibrinoid material ringed by palisading epithelioid cells (histiocytes), with lymphocytic infiltration, is the structure of a rheumatoid nodule; with 15 years of RA, ulnar deviation and high-titre RF, cavitating necrotic nodules make sense. But tuberculous and fungal granulomas can also show necrosis with epithelioid cells, and the report records no special stains or cultures — ask pathology to add them; the EULAR 2022 infection recommendations likewise ask for infection status before immunosuppression is stepped up.

text.zh-CN: 结核性肉芽肿：坏死周围有类上皮细胞就是干酪样坏死，痰检阴性在结核中很常见，应开始抗结核治疗
text.en: Tuberculous granulomas: necrosis ringed by epithelioid cells is caseation, and negative sputum is common in TB, so start anti-TB treatment

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。坏死周围的类上皮细胞并非结核所特有，报告描述的是纤维素样物质而不是干酪样坏死，也没有记录抗酸染色或培养阳性。结核要靠标本的抗酸染色、培养或分子检测来确认（ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017）；应请病理科补做，而不是凭形态开始数月的治疗。
feedback.en: No. Epithelioid cells around necrosis are not specific to TB; the report describes fibrinoid material, not caseation, and records no positive acid-fast stain or culture. TB is confirmed on the specimen's acid-fast stain, culture or molecular test (ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017) — ask pathology for them rather than start months of treatment on morphology.

text.zh-CN: ANCA 阴性的肉芽肿性多血管炎：坏死伴栅栏状组织细胞是它的标志，应开始利妥昔单抗联合激素治疗
text.en: ANCA-negative granulomatosis with polyangiitis: necrosis with palisading histiocytes is its hallmark, so start rituximab with a glucocorticoid

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。坏死周围组织细胞栅栏状排列也见于肉芽肿性多血管炎，但诊断还需要血管炎的组织学证据和相应的临床表现；她 ANCA 阴性，自述没有尿血或皮肤出血（尿常规没有记录），报告也没有描述血管炎。在类风湿关节炎和高滴度类风湿因子的背景下，类风湿结节解释得更充分；而且利妥昔单抗之前须完成乙肝和结核筛查（EULAR 2022 感染筛查与预防建议）。
feedback.en: No. Palisading histiocytes around necrosis occur in GPA too, but the diagnosis needs histological vasculitis and a fitting clinical picture; her ANCA is negative, she reports no blood in her urine and no skin bleeding (no urinalysis is recorded), and the report describes no vasculitis. With RA and high-titre RF, rheumatoid nodules explain more — and rituximab would first need hepatitis B and TB screening (EULAR 2022 infection recommendations).

text.zh-CN: 卡普兰综合征（类风湿尘肺）：吸入矿物粉尘引起的类风湿结节，除脱离粉尘外不需要其他治疗
text.en: Caplan syndrome (rheumatoid pneumoconiosis): rheumatoid nodules from inhaled mineral dust, needing nothing beyond avoiding further exposure

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。卡普兰综合征需要煤尘或二氧化硅等矿物粉尘的暴露史，而她的职业和粉尘接触没有记录，不能据此诊断；即使是卡普兰综合征，痰中带血加重、炎症指标升高也需要治疗，结核同样要先排除——矿物粉尘暴露本身就会增加结核风险。
feedback.en: No. Caplan syndrome needs exposure to mineral dust such as coal or silica, and her work and dust exposure are not recorded, so it cannot be diagnosed here; even if it were, worsening bloody sputum with raised inflammatory markers needs treatment, and tuberculosis must still be excluded first — silica exposure itself raises TB risk.

text.zh-CN: 坏死性转移瘤：74 岁、双肺多发结节伴中央坏死提示肿瘤，应加做免疫组化并请肿瘤科会诊
text.en: Necrotic metastases: multiple nodules with central necrosis at 74 suggest cancer, so add immunohistochemistry and ask oncology to see her

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。报告描述的是炎性坏死、栅栏状类上皮细胞和淋巴细胞浸润，没有提到肿瘤细胞；仅凭年龄和坏死不能诊断转移瘤。如果标本不足以诊断，下一步是重复活检，而不是在没有肿瘤证据时启动肿瘤诊疗路径。
feedback.en: No. The report describes inflammatory necrosis, palisading epithelioid cells and lymphocytic infiltration — no tumour cells; age and necrosis alone do not make metastases. Were the sample non-diagnostic, a repeat biopsy would be the step, not an oncology pathway without evidence of tumour.

prompt.zh-CN: 你把病理判读为类风湿结节。她的类风湿关节炎从未系统治疗，入院时 C 反应蛋白和血沉都很高。下列哪些应列入她的治疗方案？（多选）
prompt.en: You have read the biopsy as rheumatoid nodules. Her rheumatoid arthritis has never been treated consistently, and her CRP and ESR were high on admission. Which of these belong in her treatment plan? Select all that apply.

need.en: First commit to a reading of the pathology (decision 3).

text.zh-CN: 标本染色阴性后，口服泼尼松作短期桥接，用最低有效剂量并写明减量时间表
text.en: Oral prednisone as a short bridge once the specimen's stains are negative, at the lowest effective dose, with a written taper

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。标本的抗酸染色和真菌染色阴性（请病理科补做——报告没有记录）、组织学又支持类风湿结节之后，激素可以控制炎症；组织培养需要数周，减量期间仍要警惕感染。EULAR 2022 类风湿关节炎管理建议（及其 2025 更新）把激素定位为短期桥接治疗，并要求在临床可行时尽快减量、停用。
feedback.en: Select. Once the specimen's acid-fast and fungal stains are negative (ask pathology for them — the report records none) and the histology supports rheumatoid nodules, a glucocorticoid can settle the inflammation; tissue cultures take weeks, so stay alert to infection while it is tapered. The EULAR 2022 RA recommendations (and their 2025 update) position glucocorticoid as a short-term bridge, tapered and stopped as rapidly as clinically feasible.

text.zh-CN: 与风湿免疫科共同启用传统合成改善病情抗风湿药，并按达标治疗随访
text.en: A conventional synthetic DMARD started with rheumatology and followed to target

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。她的类风湿关节炎 15 年来从未系统治疗；控制病情、摆脱对激素的依赖要靠改善病情抗风湿药。EULAR 2022（及 2025 更新）以甲氨蝶呤为锚定药；ACR 2021 指南对轻度、稳定的气道或肺实质病变以及皮下类风湿结节仍有条件地推荐甲氨蝶呤，皮下结节在用药中进展时建议换药——而甲氨蝶呤也可能加速肺内结节形成，所以她这样有空洞结节的患者，要与风湿免疫科一起结合肺部情况和肾功能选药。
feedback.en: Select. Her RA has never been treated consistently in 15 years, and control without glucocorticoid dependence comes from a DMARD. EULAR 2022 (and the 2025 update) anchors treatment on methotrexate; the ACR 2021 guideline still conditionally prefers methotrexate in mild, stable airway or parenchymal lung disease and with subcutaneous nodules, advising a switch if those nodules progress on it — and methotrexate can accelerate nodulosis in the lung too, so with her cavitating nodules the agent is chosen with rheumatology, her lungs and renal function in mind.

text.zh-CN: 开始前查乙肝标志物和 γ-干扰素释放试验；剂量大时预防肺孢子菌，长期用药时评估骨折风险
text.en: Hepatitis B serology and an IGRA before starting; Pneumocystis prophylaxis at high doses and a fracture-risk assessment for long-term use

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。EULAR 2022 感染筛查与预防建议：用抗风湿药前明确乙肝状况，激素和传统合成药之前考虑筛查潜伏结核（首选 γ-干扰素释放试验），泼尼松每日超过 15–30 mg、超过 2–4 周时考虑预防肺孢子菌。ACR 2022 指南：每日 ≥ 2.5 mg、超过 3 个月的激素，要尽早评估骨折风险，中高危者给予治疗。
feedback.en: Select. EULAR 2022 infection recommendations: establish hepatitis B status before antirheumatic drugs, consider latent TB screening (IGRA preferred) before glucocorticoids and csDMARDs, and consider Pneumocystis prophylaxis above 15–30 mg prednisolone a day for more than 2–4 weeks. ACR 2022: for ≥ 2.5 mg a day beyond 3 months, assess fracture risk early and treat medium or higher risk.

text.zh-CN: 转胸外科，把较大的几个空洞结节手术切除，以免它们再出血或成为感染灶
text.en: Refer to thoracic surgery to resect the larger cavitating nodules, so that they cannot bleed again or harbour infection

feedback.zh-CN: 不选。结节双肺多发，手术无法全部切除；类风湿结节可随病情控制而缩小，感染要靠取样和针对性治疗来处理，手术只用于大咯血、气胸或怀疑恶变等并发症，而她没有这些记录。
feedback.en: Do not select. The nodules are multiple and in both lungs, beyond resection; rheumatoid nodules may regress as the disease is controlled, infection is handled by sampling and targeted treatment, and surgery is kept for complications such as massive haemoptysis, pneumothorax or suspected malignancy, none of which is recorded for her.

text.zh-CN: 不用激素，改为长期口服预防性抗生素，防止肺内空洞里的感染再次复燃
text.en: Long-term prophylactic antibiotics in place of a glucocorticoid, to keep infection in the cavities from flaring again

feedback.zh-CN: 不选。组织学支持类风湿结节，长期抗生素既治不了结节，也治不了关节炎，对分枝杆菌和真菌感染也起不到预防作用，还带来耐药和不良反应；她需要的是有针对性的预防（剂量达到阈值时预防肺孢子菌），而不是泛泛地用抗生素。
feedback.en: Do not select. The histology supports rheumatoid nodules; long-term antibiotics treat neither them nor the arthritis, would not prevent mycobacterial or fungal infection anyway, and add resistance and side effects. What she needs is targeted prophylaxis — against Pneumocystis once the dose threshold is reached — not blanket antibiotics.

prompt.zh-CN: 数年后，她的免疫治疗用得断断续续，病情复发、痰里又带血；针对复发抗感染治疗 12 天效果不佳，影像也没有改善。现在怎么做？
prompt.en: Some years later, after taking her immunotherapy on and off, she has relapsed with blood in her sputum again; 12 days of anti-infective treatment have had little effect and her imaging has not improved. What now?

need.zh-CN: 先问清这次复发的经过和她的用药情况，并阅读本阶段的胸部影像。
need.en: First ask about the recurrence and how she took her treatment, and read this stage's chest imaging.

text.zh-CN: 先重新送检痰分枝杆菌和真菌（痰检无果时做支气管镜灌洗），再恢复激素，换用她能坚持的改善病情药
text.en: Re-send sputum for mycobacteria and fungi (bronchoscopy and lavage if unhelpful), then restart steroid with a DMARD she can keep taking

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。用过免疫治疗、肺内有空洞的人复发时，可能是新的结核、非结核分枝杆菌或曲霉感染，抗感染无效并不能排除它们，所以先重新取样，新的痰检结果出来之前再次实施空气传播隔离；EULAR 2022 感染筛查与预防建议要求在免疫抑制期间定期重新评估感染风险。不规律用药之后的复发提示炎症复燃：恢复激素作为桥接，同时解决依从性，与风湿免疫科一起选她能坚持的改善病情药——她用过什么药没有记录，而甲氨蝶呤本身也可能促使结节增多——这是 EULAR 2022 及其 2025 更新中治疗的基础。
feedback.en: Correct. In someone on immunotherapy with lung cavities, a recurrence may be a new tuberculosis, non-tuberculous mycobacterial or Aspergillus infection, and failure of antibiotics excludes none of them — so re-sample first, with airborne precautions again until the new sputum results are back; the EULAR 2022 infection recommendations ask for infection risk to be reassessed periodically during immunosuppression. A recurrence after irregular treatment suggests a flare: restart the glucocorticoid as a bridge and tackle adherence with a DMARD she can keep taking, chosen with rheumatology — the drug she took is not recorded, and methotrexate itself can drive nodulosis — the basis of treatment in EULAR 2022 and its 2025 update.

text.zh-CN: 12 天无效说明是耐药菌：加用碳青霉烯类和抗真菌药，经验性再治 4 周，之后复查影像
text.en: Twelve days without effect means resistant organisms: add a carbapenem and an antifungal empirically for four more weeks, then re-image

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。没有新的病原学证据就层层升级抗感染治疗，既找不到病因，又推迟了对炎症复燃的治疗；曲霉、分枝杆菌等感染要先在标本中确认，再针对性用药——这与 ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 先取得细菌学证据、再治疗结核的原则一致。
feedback.en: No. Escalating anti-infectives without new microbiology finds no cause and delays treatment of a flare; Aspergillus or mycobacterial infection is confirmed on samples first and then treated specifically — the same principle as ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017, bacteriology before TB treatment.

text.zh-CN: 不规律用药之后的复发就是炎症复燃：直接甲泼尼龙 500 mg 冲击 3 天，不必再做感染检查
text.en: A recurrence after irregular treatment is simply a flare: give pulse methylprednisolone 500 mg for three days, with no further infection tests

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。复燃确实可能，但用过免疫治疗、有空洞的患者首先要排除新的感染；冲击剂量用于危及器官或生命的病变，类风湿结节不在此列，而在感染未排除时冲击可能致命。EULAR 2022 感染筛查与预防建议对每日超过 15–30 mg 泼尼松的治疗已建议考虑预防肺孢子菌。
feedback.en: No. A flare is possible, but in someone on immunotherapy with cavities a new infection comes first; pulse doses are for organ- or life-threatening disease, which rheumatoid nodules are not, and a pulse with infection not excluded can be fatal. The EULAR 2022 infection recommendations already advise considering Pneumocystis prophylaxis above 15–30 mg prednisolone a day.

text.zh-CN: 复发是免疫治疗惹的祸：永久停用所有免疫抑制药物，只用抗生素治疗
text.en: The immunotherapy caused the recurrence: stop all immunosuppressive drugs for good and treat with antibiotics alone

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。她恰恰是在用药不规律之后复发的；停掉所有治疗会让类风湿关节炎和肺部结节失去控制，而 12 天的抗感染治疗已经效果不佳。即使怀疑是药物本身促使结节增多（甲氨蝶呤可以如此），也应换用另一种改善病情药，而不是什么都不用：先排除感染，再恢复有效、能坚持的治疗（EULAR 2022 及其 2025 更新）。
feedback.en: No. She relapsed precisely after taking treatment irregularly; stopping everything leaves the arthritis and the nodules uncontrolled, and 12 days of anti-infectives have already failed. Even if the drug itself were suspected of driving the nodules (methotrexate can), the answer would be a different DMARD, not none: exclude infection, then restore effective treatment she can sustain (EULAR 2022 and its 2025 update).

text.zh-CN: 立即换用另一种抗生素，同时加用激素，把感染和炎症一并覆盖，不再等新的检查结果
text.en: Change the antibiotics and add a glucocorticoid straight away, covering infection and inflammation together without waiting for new tests

feedback.zh-CN: 接近，但不是最佳。记录中的团队调整了抗生素并加用激素，她随后好转；记录没有写明他们是否先重新送检。按现行做法，用过免疫治疗、肺内有空洞的人在加强免疫抑制之前应先重新取样（EULAR 2022 感染筛查与预防建议要求定期重新评估感染风险）；两种治疗同时改变，也无法判断是哪一种起了作用，而且长期用药和依从性仍没有解决。
feedback.en: Close, but not best. The recorded team changed the antibiotics and added a glucocorticoid and she improved; whether they re-sampled first is not recorded. Today, someone on immunotherapy with lung cavities is re-sampled before immunosuppression is stepped up (the EULAR 2022 infection recommendations ask for infection risk to be reassessed periodically); changing both at once also means neither can be credited, and maintenance treatment and adherence are still unaddressed.

text.zh-CN: 问清咳嗽和痰中带血持续了多久、血量多少，以及别处有无出血
text.en: Established how long the cough and blood-streaked sputum had lasted, how much blood there was and whether she bled anywhere else

text.zh-CN: 询问类风湿关节炎及其治疗、结核和糖尿病史、用药，以及结核接触史
text.en: Asked about her rheumatoid arthritis and its treatment, previous TB and diabetes, her medicines and any TB contact

text.zh-CN: 听诊双肺并检查双手关节
text.en: Auscultated the lungs and examined the hands

text.zh-CN: 入院时调阅胸部影像，并阅读血常规与炎症指标、类风湿因子和自身抗体
text.en: On admission, read the chest imaging, the blood count with inflammatory markers and the rheumatoid factor with autoantibodies

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把排除感染（首先是结核）放在第一位
text.en: Put the exclusion of infection, tuberculosis above all, first at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 入院即送检痰分枝杆菌，并在结果回报前实施空气传播隔离
text.en: Sent sputum for mycobacteria on admission and kept her in airborne precautions until the results were back

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择组织学诊断，查过凝血后在痰检回报时申请活检，没有用诊断性抗结核治疗代替
text.en: Chose tissue diagnosis at the first attempt, requested the biopsy once the sputum results were in and clotting was checked, and used no diagnostic anti-TB trial instead

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把病理判读为类风湿结节，以排除分枝杆菌、真菌和血管炎为前提，并申请了标本的特殊染色和培养
text.en: Read the pathology as rheumatoid nodules at the first attempt, conditional on excluding mycobacteria, fungi and vasculitis, and asked for the specimen's stains and cultures

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即制订完整方案；组织学之后才开始激素，查乙肝和潜伏结核，给予伴随预防并请风湿免疫科共管
text.en: Set the full plan at the first attempt; started the glucocorticoid only after the histology, screened for hepatitis B and latent TB, gave companion prophylaxis and shared care with rheumatology

text.zh-CN: 没有在痰检结果和组织学之前（或复发时重新送检之前）使用激素，也没有用激素冲击
text.en: Gave no glucocorticoid before the sputum results and histology (or, at the recurrence, before re-sampling), and no pulse

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即在复发时先重新取样、再恢复治疗，实际重新送检了痰并安排出院计划
text.en: At the recurrence, chose re-sampling before restarting treatment at the first attempt, actually re-sent sputum and set a discharge plan

text.zh-CN: 向她解释为什么先查结核再用激素、为什么要活检，以及长期治疗要注意什么
text.en: Explained to her why TB comes before any steroid, why a biopsy is needed and what long-term treatment involves

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（Calgary–Cambridge：开始接诊、收集信息、解释与计划、结束）：自我介绍，先了解她对自己病情的理解，并接住她“是不是肺癌”的担心；用通俗的话说明肺里的空洞可能是感染，其中结核能治好但会传染，所以要先留痰化验、暂时住单间，这是为了保护她和别人，不是责怪她；说明为什么现在还不能用激素；活检时讲清目的、可能的风险（气胸、出血）并取得知情同意；拿到结果后解释这是类风湿关节炎在肺里长出的结节，同时说明还要排除什么；讲清激素要按计划减量、不能自行停药，改善病情药需要长期规律服用，以及预防用药和复查安排；复发时不指责她用药不规律，而是了解原因、一起找到她能坚持的方案。坦诚回应关于肺癌的担心：说明活检看到了什么、还有哪些不确定，不作虚假保证，不承诺病例没有记录的结局；用“请您复述一下”确认理解，留出提问时间，说明下一步。不编造病例中没有的检查结果或药物剂量。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge: initiating, gathering, explaining and planning, closing): introduces themselves, first finds out what she understands about her illness and picks up her fear that it is lung cancer; explains in plain words that the cavities in her lungs could be an infection — tuberculosis is curable but catching — so sputum tests and a single room come first, to protect her and others, not as a judgement on her; says why a steroid cannot be started yet; before the biopsy explains its purpose and risks (a collapsed lung, bleeding) and obtains consent; once the result is back explains that these are nodules from her rheumatoid arthritis, and what still has to be excluded; explains that the steroid is tapered to a plan and never stopped suddenly, that the arthritis medicine must be taken regularly for the long term, and the prophylaxis and follow-up; at the recurrence does not blame her for taking treatment irregularly but explores why and agrees a plan she can keep to. Answers the cancer worry honestly — what the biopsy showed and what remains uncertain — without false reassurance or promises about an outcome the case does not record; checks understanding by teach-back, leaves room for questions and says what happens next. Invents no result or dose the case does not record.

name.zh-CN: 葛护士

knowledge.zh-CN: 入院交班（ISBAR）：74岁女性，今日收住院，反复咳嗽、痰中带血 10 年，近 15 天加重。病房可以腾出一间关门的单人间用于隔离；痰盒、采血管和外科口罩在治疗车上，医用防护口罩（N95）和病历终端在护士站。复述医嘱并完成护理范围内的操作（留痰、采血、隔离、给药）；只报告已经回报的结果，不解读、不诊断。被问到生命体征、体温或体重时，如实说本病例没有可报的记录，绝不报出数字。
knowledge.en: Admission handover (ISBAR): a 74-year-old woman admitted today with ten years of recurrent cough and blood-streaked sputum, worse for the last 15 days. A single room with a closing door can be freed for isolation; sputum pots, blood tubes and surgical masks are on the treatment cart, and N95 respirators and the records terminal are at the nurses' station. Reads orders back and carries out nursing-scope tasks (sputum samples, bloods, isolation, medicines); reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses. Asked for vital signs, temperature or weight, says plainly that the case has nothing recorded to report — never a number.

name.zh-CN: 龚医生（呼吸与危重症医学科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教（PEARLS），只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“双肺空洞结节的鉴别里，哪些可治又会传染？”“痰检阴性能排除结核吗？”“抗感染后短暂好转又加重，说明什么、不能说明什么？”“活检之前要先确认什么？”“坏死周围栅栏状排列还可能是哪些病？报告缺了哪些染色和培养？”“长期用激素之前要筛查什么、预防什么？”“她免疫治疗用得断断续续，复发时你最担心什么？”“抗生素和激素同时调整，结局能证明是谁起了作用吗？”。可以讲解 ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 结核病诊断指南、WHO 2019 结核感染预防与控制指南、WS 288—2017 肺结核诊断、EULAR 2022 类风湿关节炎管理建议及其 2025 更新、ACR 2021 类风湿关节炎治疗指南、EULAR 2022 感染筛查与预防建议和 ACR 2022 糖皮质激素性骨质疏松指南的相关原则；学员读到相应记录之后，可以对比记录的病程（抗感染后短暂好转、第二次住院活检后加用激素、复发时同时调整抗生素并加用激素）与现行做法。不提前说出诊断或任何决策的正确选项；不补充病例中没有的资料（生命体征、体温、体重、白细胞和血小板、凝血、肝肾功能、抗 CCP、痰检方法、活检取材方式和特殊染色、所用抗生素和激素的药名与剂量、“免疫治疗”的具体药物、复发前间隔的年数以及长期随访都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Socratic preceptor (PEARLS) who asks only about information the learner already has, e.g. “Among the causes of cavitating nodules, which are treatable and transmissible?”, “Do negative sputum results exclude TB?”, “A brief response to antibiotics, then relapse — what does it show, and what not?”, “What must you confirm before a biopsy?”, “What else produces necrosis ringed by palisading cells, and which stains and cultures is the report missing?”, “Before long-term glucocorticoid, what do you screen for and what do you prevent?”, “She took her immune treatment on and off — what worries you most at the recurrence?”, “Antibiotics and glucocorticoid were changed together — can the outcome show which worked?”. May explain the relevant principles of the ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 TB diagnosis guideline, the WHO 2019 TB infection-control guideline, China's WS 288—2017 standard, the EULAR 2022 RA recommendations and their 2025 update, the ACR 2021 RA guideline, the EULAR 2022 infection screening and prophylaxis recommendations and the ACR 2022 glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis guideline, and — once the learner has read the records — contrast the recorded course (a brief response to antibiotics, a glucocorticoid added after the biopsy at her second admission, antibiotics changed and a glucocorticoid added together at the recurrence) with current practice. Never states the diagnosis or any decision's correct option before the learner commits, and adds no data the case lacks (vital signs, temperature, weight, white cells and platelets, clotting, liver and renal function, anti-CCP, the sputum methods, how the biopsy was taken and its special stains, the antibiotic and glucocorticoid names and doses, which drug the “immunotherapy” was, the years before the recurrence and long-term follow-up are not recorded).

name.zh-CN: 蒲医生（病理科）

knowledge.zh-CN: 病理科医生，只解读学员已经读过的病理报告：坏死周围类上皮细胞（组织细胞）栅栏状排列可见于类风湿结节、结核和真菌性肉芽肿以及肉芽肿性多血管炎；纤维素样物质加栅栏状结构支持类风湿结节，但定论之前应补做抗酸染色和真菌染色（六胺银、PAS），把剩余组织送分枝杆菌和真菌培养或分子检测，并复核有无血管炎和恶性细胞。不报告病例中没有的染色或培养结果（都没有记录），也不知道标本是怎样取得的。
knowledge.en: Pathologist who interprets only the pathology report the learner has read: palisading epithelioid cells (histiocytes) around necrosis occur in rheumatoid nodules, tuberculous and fungal granulomas and granulomatosis with polyangiitis; fibrinoid material with palisading favours a rheumatoid nodule, but before calling it, acid-fast and fungal stains (Grocott, PAS) should be added, remaining tissue sent for mycobacterial and fungal culture or molecular testing, and the sections reviewed for vasculitis and malignant cells. Reports no stain or culture result the case lacks (none is recorded) and does not know how the specimen was obtained.

name.zh-CN: 盛医生（风湿免疫科）

knowledge.zh-CN: 风湿免疫科医生，学员请会诊后参与。只解读学员已经读过的血液检查、类风湿因子、自身抗体和病理报告：高滴度类风湿因子与类风湿结节等关节外表现相关；ANCA 阴性降低但不能排除血管炎；类风湿结节须在排除感染之后才能确诊。可以讨论改善病情抗风湿药的选择（EULAR 2022 及其 2025 更新以甲氨蝶呤为锚定药；ACR 2021 对轻度、稳定的肺部病变和皮下类风湿结节仍有条件地推荐甲氨蝶呤，皮下结节在用药中进展时建议换药；甲氨蝶呤也可能加速肺内结节形成，这对她有空洞结节时的选药很重要）、激素桥接与减量、用药前的乙肝和潜伏结核筛查、肺孢子菌预防与骨保护，以及怎样帮助她坚持用药。不编造抗 CCP、补体、肾功能或她用过的药物（都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Rheumatologist who joins once consulted. Interprets only the blood tests, rheumatoid factor, autoantibodies and pathology report the learner has read: high-titre RF goes with nodules and other extra-articular disease; a negative ANCA lowers but does not exclude vasculitis; a rheumatoid nodule is diagnosed only once infection is excluded. Can discuss the DMARD choice (EULAR 2022 and its 2025 update anchor on methotrexate; ACR 2021 still conditionally prefers it in mild, stable lung disease and with subcutaneous nodules, and advises switching if those nodules progress on it; methotrexate can accelerate nodulosis in the lung too, which weighs on the choice for her cavitating nodules), glucocorticoid bridging and taper, hepatitis B and latent TB screening before treatment, Pneumocystis prophylaxis and bone protection, and how to help her keep taking treatment. Never invents anti-CCP, complement, renal function or the drugs she took (none is recorded).

title.zh-CN: 复盘：类风湿关节炎患者的双肺多发空洞结节
title.en: Debrief: multiple cavitating lung nodules in a woman with rheumatoid arthritis

conclusion.zh-CN: 74岁女性，15 年前诊断类风湿关节炎、未系统治疗，咳嗽、痰中带血 10 年，近 15 天加重。查体双肺小水泡音、双手掌指关节尺侧偏斜；胸部 CT 示双肺多发大小不等的结节，伴大小不等的空洞；血红蛋白 95 g/L，C 反应蛋白 95 mg/L，血沉 90 mm/h，类风湿因子 2010 IU/mL，所查 ANA 谱和 ANCA 阴性；多次痰结核检查阴性。抗感染后短暂好转，一周后加重。第二次住院肺活检（右下叶结节）见中央急性炎性坏死伴少许纤维素样物质、周围类上皮细胞栅栏状排列、间质淋巴细胞浸润，结合类风湿关节炎病史，支持肺内类风湿（坏死性）结节伴空洞形成；报告没有记录特殊染色和培养。加用激素后影像改善；数年后在免疫治疗用药不规律之后复发，抗感染 12 天效果不佳，调整抗生素并加用激素后血痰消失、空洞壁变薄，口服泼尼松出院。按现行做法：先隔离并送检痰分枝杆菌；痰检阴性后取组织（同时送染色和培养），再用激素；激素只作桥接，联用结合肺结节选择的改善病情抗风湿药，并做乙肝、潜伏结核筛查和伴随预防；复发时先重新取样排除感染。长期随访没有记录。
conclusion.en: A 74-year-old woman with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed 15 years earlier and never consistently treated had ten years of cough with blood-streaked sputum, worse for 15 days; fine crackles in both lungs; ulnar deviation of both hands. CT: multiple nodules of varying size in both lungs, with cavities of varying size. Hb 95 g/L, CRP 95 mg/L, ESR 90 mm/h, RF 2010 IU/mL; ANA panel and ANCA negative; repeated sputum TB tests negative. Antibiotics helped briefly, then she worsened a week later. A right lower-lobe biopsy at her second admission (central acute inflammatory necrosis with a little fibrinoid material, ringed by palisading epithelioid cells) supported rheumatoid nodules, with no special stains or cultures recorded; after a glucocorticoid her imaging improved. Years later, after irregular immunotherapy, she relapsed; 12 days of anti-infectives did little; after an antibiotic change plus a glucocorticoid the bloody sputum stopped and the cavity walls thinned, and she left on prednisone. Today: isolate, test sputum, get tissue with stains and cultures before any steroid, screen and protect, add a DMARD chosen with her nodules in mind, re-sample at relapse.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 在类风湿患者身上，多发空洞结节伴痰中带血首先是一个感染问题：结核可治又会传染，必须先排除。
keyReasoning.en: In a patient with RA, multiple cavitating nodules with blood-streaked sputum are first an infection problem: tuberculosis is treatable and transmissible and must be excluded.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 高滴度类风湿因子和关节畸形说明她患有病程很长的血清阳性类风湿关节炎，却说明不了空洞的原因；ANCA 阴性降低但不排除血管炎。
keyReasoning.en: High-titre RF and joint deformity show long-standing seropositive RA but not what caused the cavities; a negative ANCA lowers, but does not remove, the chance of vasculitis.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 抗感染后短暂好转又加重、痰检阴性，既证明不了细菌感染，也排除不了分枝杆菌或真菌——这正是需要组织的时候。
keyReasoning.en: A brief response and relapse on antibiotics with negative sputum proves no bacterial infection and excludes no mycobacterium or fungus — this is the point to obtain tissue.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 高滴度类风湿因子背景下，坏死周围栅栏状排列指向类风湿结节；只有抗酸、真菌染色和培养阴性，才能下定论。
keyReasoning.en: Against high-titre RF, palisading around necrosis points to a rheumatoid nodule; only negative acid-fast and fungal stains and cultures make it a conclusion.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 用药不规律之后的复发，既可能是炎症复燃，也可能是免疫抑制宿主的新感染；两者都要考虑，先取样再加强治疗。
keyReasoning.en: A recurrence after irregular treatment may be a flare or a new infection in an immunosuppressed host; weigh both, and sample before stepping treatment up.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 复发时抗生素和激素同时调整，记录中的好转不能归功于其中任何一种；单例报告只能提出假设。
keyReasoning.en: At the recurrence the antibiotics and the glucocorticoid changed together, so the recorded improvement cannot be credited to either; a single report only raises hypotheses.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单篇病例报告，本版依据 1.0.0 版提取的事实改写，尚未对照原文全文核对。它不能说明哪一种治疗起了作用（复发时抗生素和激素同时调整），也不能代表类风湿结节的一般病程。病例没有记录生命体征、白细胞和血小板、凝血、肝肾功能、痰检方法、活检取材和特殊染色、药名和剂量、复发前间隔的年数和长期随访；决策、处置选项和评分是教学设计，不改变记录的病程。
boundaries.en: A single case report, re-authored from the facts extracted for version 1.0.0 and not yet checked against the full article. It cannot show which treatment worked (the antibiotics and the glucocorticoid changed together at the recurrence), nor stand for the usual course of rheumatoid nodules. No vital signs, white cells or platelets, clotting, liver or renal function, sputum methods, biopsy technique or special stains, drug names and doses, years before the recurrence or long-term follow-up are recorded; the decisions, intervention options and scoring are teaching design and do not change the recorded course.

unknowns.zh-CN: 各阶段的生命体征、体温和体重。
unknowns.en: Vital signs, temperature and weight at any stage.

unknowns.zh-CN: 白细胞计数及分类、血小板、凝血功能、肝肾功能和尿常规；抗 CCP 抗体和补体；ANA 谱所含的抗体和 ANCA 的检测方法。
unknowns.en: White cell count and differential, platelets, clotting, liver and renal function and urinalysis; anti-CCP and complement; which antibodies the ANA panel covered and how ANCA was tested.

unknowns.zh-CN: 痰结核检查的方法和份数，是否查过非结核分枝杆菌和真菌（培养、半乳甘露聚糖等），是否做过支气管镜。
unknowns.en: The sputum methods and number of samples, whether non-tuberculous mycobacteria and fungi were sought (cultures, galactomannan), and whether bronchoscopy was done.

unknowns.zh-CN: 活检的取材方式和标本大小，以及抗酸染色、真菌染色和组织培养的结果。
unknowns.en: How the biopsy was taken and its size, and the results of acid-fast and fungal stains and tissue culture.

unknowns.zh-CN: 各阶段抗生素和激素的药名、剂量和疗程，“免疫治疗”的具体药物和剂量，以及泼尼松的出院剂量和减量方案。
unknowns.en: The antibiotic and glucocorticoid names, doses and durations at each stage, which drug the “immunotherapy” was and its dose, and the prednisone dose and taper at discharge.

unknowns.zh-CN: 首次与第二次住院之间、以及复发之前间隔的时间，她在各次住院时的年龄。
unknowns.en: The intervals between the first and second admissions and before the recurrence, and her age at each admission.

unknowns.zh-CN: 吸烟史、职业和粉尘接触史、结核接触史、过敏史和家族史。
unknowns.en: Smoking, occupation and dust exposure, TB contacts, allergies and family history.

unknowns.zh-CN: 出院后的长期随访与结局。
unknowns.en: Long-term follow-up and outcome after discharge.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 先排除结核，再谈炎症。疑似肺结核时，ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 指南要求送检痰抗酸涂片（通常 3 份）、分枝杆菌培养，并对首份标本做核酸扩增检测；WHO 2019 结核感染预防与控制指南要求对疑似传染性患者实施呼吸道隔离；我国 WS 288—2017 同样以病原学或病理学结果确诊肺结核。记录与现行做法：记录只写了“多次痰查结核阴性”，没有记录方法和隔离；按现行做法，入院当天就应隔离并送检。
teachingPoints.en: Exclude TB before treating inflammation. In suspected pulmonary TB the ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 guideline asks for sputum AFB smears (usually three), mycobacterial culture and a nucleic-acid amplification test on the first specimen; the WHO 2019 TB infection-control guideline isolates people with presumed infectious TB; China's WS 288—2017 likewise confirms pulmonary TB by bacteriology or pathology. Then and now: the record says only that repeated sputum tests were negative, without methods or isolation; today both start on the day of admission.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 痰检阴性、抗感染反应不明确时，取组织。活检标本同时送组织学、抗酸和真菌染色及培养，取材前查血小板和凝血；不要用升级抗生素、诊断性抗结核治疗或经验性激素代替诊断。培养仍是结核诊断的参考标准（ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017）。记录与现行做法：记录中的团队在第二次住院时取了活检，这是作出诊断的关键一步。
teachingPoints.en: When sputum is negative and the antibiotic response is equivocal, get tissue: send the biopsy for histology, acid-fast and fungal stains and cultures, after a platelet count and clotting screen — not escalated antibiotics, a diagnostic anti-TB trial or an empirical glucocorticoid. Culture remains the reference standard for TB (ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017). Then and now: the recorded team biopsied a nodule at her second admission — the decisive step.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 类风湿结节是排除性诊断。中央纤维素样坏死、周围组织细胞栅栏状排列是它的结构，多见于高滴度类风湿因子、病程长的患者，可形成空洞并引起痰中带血；结核和真菌肉芽肿、肉芽肿性多血管炎和肿瘤要靠染色、培养和临床表现来排除——本病例的病理报告没有记录特殊染色和培养，用激素之前应请病理科补做。
teachingPoints.en: A rheumatoid nodule is a diagnosis of exclusion. Central fibrinoid necrosis ringed by palisading histiocytes is its structure; it goes with high-titre RF and long-standing disease, and can cavitate and bleed. Tuberculous and fungal granulomas, GPA and tumour are excluded by stains, cultures and the clinical picture — this report records no special stains or cultures; ask pathology for them before the glucocorticoid.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 激素是桥，改善病情抗风湿药是路。EULAR 2022 建议（及其 2025 更新）以甲氨蝶呤为锚定药，激素作短期桥接并尽快减停；ACR 2021 指南对轻度、稳定的肺部病变和皮下类风湿结节仍有条件地推荐甲氨蝶呤，皮下结节在用药中进展时建议换药——而甲氨蝶呤也可能加速肺内结节形成，所以对有空洞的肺结节，要与风湿免疫科一起选药。记录与现行做法：记录写了活检后加用激素，没有记录同时启用改善病情药；之后的“免疫治疗”用得并不规律。
teachingPoints.en: Glucocorticoid is the bridge; a DMARD is the road. EULAR 2022 (and its 2025 update) anchors RA treatment on methotrexate with glucocorticoid as a short bridge, tapered and stopped as fast as feasible; ACR 2021 still conditionally prefers methotrexate in mild, stable lung disease and with subcutaneous nodules, advising a switch if those nodules progress on it — and methotrexate can accelerate nodulosis in the lung too, so for cavitating lung nodules the agent is chosen with rheumatology. Then and now: the record notes a glucocorticoid after the biopsy but records no DMARD started with it, and the later “immunotherapy” was taken irregularly.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 免疫抑制之前先筛查，同时做预防。EULAR 2022 感染筛查与预防建议：用抗风湿药前明确乙肝状况（HBsAg、抗-HBc），激素和传统合成药之前考虑筛查潜伏结核（首选 γ-干扰素释放试验），泼尼松每日超过 15–30 mg、超过 2–4 周时考虑预防肺孢子菌。ACR 2022 指南：每日 ≥ 2.5 mg、超过 3 个月的激素，尽早评估骨折风险，中高危者给予抗骨质疏松治疗。本病例没有记录其中任何一项。
teachingPoints.en: Screen and protect before immunosuppression. EULAR 2022 infection recommendations: establish hepatitis B status (HBsAg, anti-HBc) before antirheumatic drugs, consider latent TB screening (IGRA preferred) before glucocorticoids and csDMARDs, and consider Pneumocystis prophylaxis above 15–30 mg prednisolone a day for more than 2–4 weeks. ACR 2022: for ≥ 2.5 mg a day beyond 3 months, assess fracture risk early and treat medium or higher risk. None of these is recorded for her.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 复发时先取样，同时解决依从性。用过免疫治疗、肺内有空洞的患者复发，可能是复燃，也可能是新的结核、非结核分枝杆菌或曲霉感染；EULAR 2022 建议在免疫抑制期间定期重新评估感染风险。记录与现行做法：记录中的团队同时调整抗生素并加用激素后她好转，但没有记录是否重新送检；两种治疗同时改变，无法判断是哪一种起了作用。
teachingPoints.en: At a recurrence, sample first and tackle adherence. In someone on immunotherapy with lung cavities a relapse may be a flare or a new TB, non-tuberculous mycobacterial or Aspergillus infection; EULAR 2022 asks for infection risk to be reassessed periodically during immunosuppression. Then and now: the recorded team changed the antibiotics and added a glucocorticoid together and she improved, but whether she was re-sampled is not recorded — and with two treatments changed at once, neither can be credited.

unknowns.zh-CN: 各阶段的生命体征、体温和体重。
unknowns.en: Vital signs, temperature and weight at any stage.

unknowns.zh-CN: 白细胞计数及分类、血小板、凝血功能、肝肾功能和尿常规；抗 CCP 抗体和补体；ANA 谱所含的抗体和 ANCA 的检测方法。
unknowns.en: White cell count and differential, platelets, clotting, liver and renal function and urinalysis; anti-CCP and complement; which antibodies the ANA panel covered and how ANCA was tested.

unknowns.zh-CN: 痰结核检查的方法和份数，是否查过非结核分枝杆菌和真菌（培养、半乳甘露聚糖等），是否做过支气管镜。
unknowns.en: The sputum methods and number of samples, whether non-tuberculous mycobacteria and fungi were sought (cultures, galactomannan), and whether bronchoscopy was done.

unknowns.zh-CN: 活检的取材方式和标本大小，以及抗酸染色、真菌染色和组织培养的结果。
unknowns.en: How the biopsy was taken and its size, and the results of acid-fast and fungal stains and tissue culture.

unknowns.zh-CN: 各阶段抗生素和激素的药名、剂量和疗程，“免疫治疗”的具体药物和剂量，以及泼尼松的出院剂量和减量方案。
unknowns.en: The antibiotic and glucocorticoid names, doses and durations at each stage, which drug the “immunotherapy” was and its dose, and the prednisone dose and taper at discharge.

unknowns.zh-CN: 首次与第二次住院之间、以及复发之前间隔的时间，她在各次住院时的年龄。
unknowns.en: The intervals between the first and second admissions and before the recurrence, and her age at each admission.

unknowns.zh-CN: 吸烟史、职业和粉尘接触史、结核接触史、过敏史和家族史。
unknowns.en: Smoking, occupation and dust exposure, TB contacts, allergies and family history.

unknowns.zh-CN: 出院后的长期随访与结局。
unknowns.en: Long-term follow-up and outcome after discharge.
